feeds.title: Spalanz.com » Lovecraft
feeds.description: The author started this blog in April 2014 as a very informal, casual corner of the internet where he posts stuff that he happens to have an interest in. Learn about Lovecraft from his informative articles.

feeds.title: Shoggoth.net
feeds.description: Shoggoth.net is a website dedicated to the promotion and support of Cthulhu Mythos & Weird Fiction. From Literature, Gaming, Product Reviews, Comedy, Poetry, etc they try to have it all. They have been around since the late 1990's with a hiatus from 2008-2014 due to data loss from emergency migration. Check out our articles for information on passports.

feeds.title: Deep Cuts Lovecraftian Blog
feeds.description: Deep Cuts in a Lovecraftian Vein is a review site, dedicated to examining some of these lesser-known works of the Mythos. Stories he particularly wants to focus on will involve writers and protagonists that are female or POC, LGBTQ issues, and related themes of sex, gender, race, and all the other bits and pieces that people don't normally like to talk about.

feeds.title: Cthulhu Reborn
feeds.description: This site provides a home for professional-looking typeset renditions of old, classic, and best of all free 'Call of Cthulhu' scenarios. The blog has articles on horror games, Lovecraft, and more.

feeds.title: The Lovecraft Ezine
feeds.description: The Lovecraft Ezine is a free online magazine featuring Lovecraftian horror and the Cthulhu Mythos. The blog is dedicated to articles on Lovecraft, weird fiction books, video games, horror movies, and more.

feeds.title: Cthulhumaniacs.com
feeds.description: Discover Cthulhumaniacs, your go-to destination for whimsical Lovecraft-inspired clothing, curiosities, and more. Laugh in the face of cosmic horror with their unique, playful designs, and explore their themed cycling gear, T-Shirts, and accessories that blend humor with the eerie allure of H.P. Lovecraft's universe.

feeds.title: C is for Cthulhu Blog
feeds.description: C is for Cthulhu an online shop dedicated to Sharing the Lovecraft! They create Lovecraft-themed books, t-shirts, posters, and more for young and old ones!

feeds.title: CthulhuWho1's Blog
feeds.description: CthulhuWho1's Blog - Truthfully, this Blog is a companion to my Flickr Collections, and it exists to give me a wall to post (mostly Lovecraft-related) announcements on that will get quickly indexed by Google and other search engines; and it also exists as an audio file sharing site for the Lovecraft related mp3 files that can't be uploaded to Flickr. The blog offers articles on wandering in Lovecraft.
